text: dsh-tool-budget 是 DSH 插件，按 agent 会话累计工具调用，并在超过上限时拦截。默认允许 80 次，job_output、job_list 和 job_kill 默认不计；可用 include、exclude 模式筛选工具。每个 agent 独立计数，并在系统提示中展示预算。适合需要控制 DSH 会话工具调用量的用户，无需额外账号或密钥。

dsh-tool-budget counts tool calls per DSH agent session and blocks calls over a configurable limit. By default, it allows 80 calls and excludes job_output, job_list, and job_kill. Include and exclude patterns select counted tools. Each agent has its own counter.
想给每个 DSH 会话设置工具调用次数上限
DSH agent 一直调用工具，怎么限制总次数？
希望超过预算后自动阻止后续工具调用
让不同 agent 各自统计自己的工具调用额度
How can I cap tool calls within each DSH agent session?
Stop an agent from making more tool calls after a set budget
怎样让调用次数限制只统计指定的工具？
dsh-tool-budget 的功能「会话调用上限」：按 agent 会话累计工具调用，并在超过 maxCalls 后由 guard 拒绝后续调用。默认上限为 80 次。
dsh-tool-budget 的功能「按工具模式筛选」：通过 include 与 exclude 中的通配符模式选择计数工具；默认排除 job_output、job_list 和 job_kill。
dsh-tool-budget 的功能「每个 agent 独立计数」：插件以 agent 对象为键分别保存会话计数，并在超限时返回包含工具名和计数的阻止消息。
Prevent long tool call loops from using up a session budget

dsh-tool-budget README · Why：Repeat-stop catches identical spam. Budget catches “many different tools forever” in one session—useful when long WSL tasks burn API quota.

Default: **80** tracked calls allowed; the **81st** is denied. Job status tools are excluded by default.

This is a **safety rail**, not a product license limit. Raise `maxCalls` or disable if it feels tight.

dsh-tool-budget README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-tool-budget
```

Restart `dsh web`. No new tool. Blocks show as `dsh-tool-budget: blocked` in Trajectory.

dsh-tool-budget README · Config：```yaml
- id: dsh-tool-budget
  name: dsh-tool-budget
  config:
    enabled: true

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `maxCalls` | `80` | Allowed tracked calls per session |
| `exclude` | job_* | Names that do not count |
| `include` | (empty) | If set, only these names count |

dsh-tool-budget README · vs dsh-repeat-stop：| Plugin | What it blocks |
|--------|----------------|
| `dsh-repeat-stop` | Consecutive identical calls |
| `dsh-tool-budget` | Total tool calls in the whole session |

dsh-tool-budget README · Test：```sh
npm test
```

dsh-tool-budget README · FAQ：**Does this replace dsh-repeat-stop?** No. Repeat-stop blocks identical streaks; this caps total calls per session.

**Will it block job_* tools?** Not by default — they are excluded so long-running shell jobs can still be observed.

**How do I raise the limit?** Set `config.maxCalls` in your profile `cordis.patch.yml` and restart `dsh web`.
